messages.subject: Mining, Energy & ESG Executive | Government Relations, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Oxana Bristowe Team,

Your executive-search work across energy, mining and ESG-aligned leadership makes this a particularly strong fit for my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where resources or energy strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, sustainability and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
